subject: Candlekeep scholars present
fact: Four people in Candlekeep did not appear to want Daral Yashenti dead.
source_quote: four people in Candlekeep who did not appear to want him dead

subject: Candlekeep High Tower key description
fact: The keys to Candlekeep's High Tower are completely magical.
source_quote: They're the two keys that open Candlekeep's High Tower. They're not some lowly, cheap-ass keys you pick up at a locksmith's.

subject: key magical status
fact: The key in Grygum's hand was not magical.
source_quote: The key sat in the middle of all that light and stayed dark

subject: Candlekeep teleportation ward location
fact: The ward that protects against teleportation lives in one room, the room locked by the two high tower keys.
source_quote: the ward, Daral realized as he said it, lives in one room. The room locked by the two high tower keys

subject: Bookwyrm's spell level
fact: Bookwyrm was an eighteenth-level magic user.
source_quote: She was an eighteenth-level magic user at rest in her own tower

subject: Bookwyrm's spell slots
fact: Bookwyrm's ninth-level slots probably held Validate Citation and Identify False Citation.
source_quote: a woman whose ninth-level slots probably held Validate Citation and Identify False Citation

subject: Kalan's likely location
fact: Kalan was likely at the Sea Warden's Tower, down among the other Watchers.
source_quote: Daral named the likeliest place: the Sea Warden's Tower, down among the other Watchers

subject: sequence of events
fact: The three events — false key, alarm bell, Bookwyrm's death — arrived together in the same quarter hour.
source_quote: all in the same quarter hour

subject: sequence of events
fact: The bell tolling was a pattern, not the hour.

subject: decoy key origin
fact: The key given to Grygum and passed to Daz was a decoy from the first hour.
source_quote: the key he'd pressed on me with that strange phrasing, the one I'd handed to Daz, the one that nearly got Daz killed, had been a decoy from the first hour

subject: Tadric's role
fact: Tadric, a young Watcher, was posted to guard Janussi's door and held the real key.
source_quote: Tadric. The young Watcher who had guarded Janussi's door

subject: Tadric's location
fact: Tadric was posted in the North Galleries.
source_quote: I posted him away from the barracks on purpose. Run! He pushed a key into my hand. A Watcher's Stair key, for the barred door that cuts straight through to the North Gallery.

subject: sequence of key handoffs
fact: The key was passed from Grygum's hand to Daz's.
source_quote: Fembris had watched the key pass from Grygum's hand to Daz's

subject: sequence of key handoffs
fact: Kalan had given the decoy key to Grygum before it was passed to Daz.
source_quote: the key he'd pressed on me with that strange phrasing

subject: session date
fact: The events occur on the day the bell tolled incorrectly and Bookwyrm was killed.
